overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an insufficiently specific 'HCA fees' notice for May 30 and by missing the deadline to respond to a May 30 complaint; the July 18 complaint topic was adequate and other claims were declined.

allegations.summary: May 30 meeting notice listed the topic 'HCA fees' without spelling out the acronym, allegedly too vague for the public to understand.
allegations.key_passage: We agree, and find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it posted insufficiently specific notice of its May 30 meeting.

allegations.summary: July 18 notice included a discussion item about a complaint filed against the Board, allegedly vague and lacking detail.
allegations.key_passage: Although the public would have been better informed had the notice topic clarified that the complaint was brought pursuant to the Open Meeting Law, in this instance we find that the notice topic was sufficiently specific where it identified the complainant by name.

allegations.summary: Complainants suggested the other 16 discussion topics on the July 18 notice were also insufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: Of the 16 remaining topics, none is deficient on its face such that we would find a violation of our own accord, and we decline to fully investigate the sufficiency of each topic without any explicit allegation from the complainants.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to respond to a May 30 Open Meeting Law complaint within the time required by law.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it failed to respond to the May 30 Complaint in a timely manner.

allegations.summary: Complainant argued the Board should not have reviewed a complaint about a member's conduct because that member had resigned before the complaint was filed.
allegations.key_passage: Nothing within the Open Meeting Law prohibits review of a timely filed Open Meeting Law complaint once the member accused of the violative act resigns

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board acted improperly in other ways in responding to Open Meeting Law complaints.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the remaining allegations of the complaints.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a board member made damaging misrepresentations about him at a meeting and engaged in a pattern of harassment.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review allegations of defamation and harassment, as these allegations fall outside the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
